name: quackscale
description: Embeds a Tailscale client (libtailscale) inside DuckDB so a process joins your tailnet and reaches peers over encrypted WireGuard — read a peer's HTTP assets as local files and run Quack/DuckLake workloads across the mesh, with no VPN sidecar and no public port.

cta.title: Quack & DuckLake over Tailscale
cta.description: QuackScale puts DuckDB on your private Tailscale/Headscale network so engines find each other on 100.x addresses and MagicDNS, then ATTACH and query across the encrypted mesh.

notice.title: Platform support & docs
notice.body: QuackScale embeds a Tailscale client and is published only for **Linux** and **macOS (Apple Silicon)** — not Windows, Intel macOS, or WASM. Function-level reference docs will be generated once a community-registry binary is available for this DuckDB version.

quickStart.title: Join the tailnet and serve a Quack endpoint
Attach to a peer over WireGuard and query it
Read a peer's HTTP asset as if it were a local file
